method: plain string search on the locally held text of the repealing act, no model: (1) the target's number in a sentence carrying a repeal verb; (2) under a repeal list whose lead-in carries the verb; (3) in the annex of repealed acts a recast's repealing article points to. Never a judgment, always a quoted span.

calibration.against: the human audit of 2026-09-10, 27 repeals read by hand
calibration.precision: 19/19 — the machine never claimed a repeal the human had refused
calibration.recall: 19/21 — it misses 2: one where the number never appears in the text (the repeal is implicit), one where the target is an international agreement with no printed number (named in an annex by its title)
calibration.reading: the share below is a lower bound: on the audited sample the machine finds 90 % of what a human finds, and invents nothing

reserves: only the acts whose text is held locally (dump of acts in force + lot B) are asked; 797 have no text at all
the calibration rests on 27 facts read by one human: the recall of 90 % carries a wide interval
a target without a printed number (an agreement, a protocol) cannot be searched: 762 facts left open, not counted as absent
